references.text: Psalm 103:3, which speaks of forgiveness of all your sins, reflects Jesus' act of forgiving the paralytic's sins.
Isaiah 43:25, where God speaks of forgiving sins for His own sake, points to God's authority to forgive sins, as demonstrated by Jesus.
Micah 7:18, which describes God as a forgiver of sins, emphasizes Jesus' divine nature and authority to forgive sins.
Matthew 9:2 shows a parallel event where Jesus forgives the sins of a paralytic, highlighting His power and mercy.
Luke 5:20, where Jesus also forgives sins, demonstrates consistency in Jesus' teaching and actions regarding forgiveness.
Matthew 1:21, which speaks of Jesus coming to save His people from their sins, explains the reason why Jesus has authority to forgive sins.
